method: Real physics and element behaviors, normal button inputs only; deterministic seeds; no ball placement or forced scores. The reactive player varies flipper timing and uses a legal Up nudge after a second at rest, respecting the cooldown.
limitation: Scores are playability proxies. Player enjoyment, aesthetics and physical button feel require human playtesting.
